CommunityApplications.Profile: This legacy BookshelfNG listing is being prepared for migration to ChaptarrNG. Back up appdata before changing the template. Public ChaptarrNG v0.9.977 supports migration-158 SQLite. Upgrade BookshelfNG to 0.4.21.71 first; the version-aware older-schema fix is merged to ChaptarrNG main but is not publicly released. Keep the migration template unpublished until the retirement freeze ends and the Community Apps upgrade flow is validated. New installations should use ChaptarrNG.
